push.name: Push-Up
push.cue: From a high plank, hands under shoulders. Tuck elbows 45° to ribs, lower chest to floor, press to full lockout.

push.name: DB Push Press
push.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders. Dip 2 inches through legs, drive up and punch DBs to overhead lockout.

push.name: DB Floor Press
push.cue: Lie flat, DBs at chest, feet planted. Press straight up to lockout, pause triceps on floor each rep.

push.name: Pike Push-Up
push.cue: Hands shoulder-width, hips piked high over shoulders. Bend elbows, lower crown to floor, press up tall.

push.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
push.cue: Kick up facing the wall, hands 6 in. from it. Tight core, lower nose to floor, press to lockout.

push.name: Banded Push-Up
push.cue: Wrap heavy band across upper back, hold ends under each palm. Press explosively, band resists at lockout.

push.name: Burpee
push.cue: From standing, drop hands to floor, jump feet back to plank. Push-up, jump feet to hands, explode into a full jump with arms overhead.

push.name: DB Thruster
push.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders. Squat below parallel, drive up and press DBs to full overhead lockout in one fluid motion.

push.name: DB Devil Press
push.cue: DBs on floor beside feet. Burpee over the DBs, then swing both DBs from the floor to full overhead lockout in one move.

push.name: DB Strict Press
push.cue: Stand tall, rack both DBs on shoulders, elbows under wrists. Press straight overhead to lockout, no leg drive, control down.

pull.name: Pull-Up
pull.cue: Overhand grip on the bar, full dead hang. Pull until chin clears bar, control the lower.

pull.name: Chin-Up
pull.cue: Underhand grip, shoulder-width, full hang. Pull chin over bar, squeeze biceps hard at top.

pull.name: Banded Pull-Apart
pull.cue: Hold light band at arm's length, palms down. Pull band apart to chest, pinch shoulder blades together.

pull.name: DB Bent-Over Row
pull.cue: Hinge forward with DBs hanging at knees, flat back. Row both DBs to hips, elbows tight to ribs.

pull.name: Single-Arm DB Row
pull.cue: Brace one hand on a bench, DB in the other. Row DB to hip, drive elbow to the ceiling.

pull.name: Banded Face Pull
pull.cue: Anchor light band at face height. Pull ends to forehead, elbows high, rotate knuckles back.

pull.name: Inverted Row (bar)
pull.cue: Set the bar low, hang underneath with heels on floor. Pull chest to bar, body in one straight line.

pull.name: DB Renegade Row
pull.cue: Plank position gripping both DBs on the floor, feet wide. Row one DB to hip, set it down, alternate sides. Stay rigid.

pull.name: DB High Pull
pull.cue: DBs at thighs, soft knees. Explosive hip drive, shrug hard, pull elbows high above shoulders, DBs to chin level.

pull.name: DB Upright Row
pull.cue: Hold both light DBs in front of thighs. Pull straight up along the body, elbows leading high, to chin height.

squat.name: Air Squat
squat.cue: Feet shoulder-width, arms forward for balance. Sit hips back and down, hip below knee, drive up tall.

squat.name: DB Goblet Squat
squat.cue: Hold one DB vertically at chest, elbows under. Squat deep, elbows inside knees, stand tall.

squat.name: DB Front Squat
squat.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders, elbows pointed up. Squat deep with tall torso, drive up through heels.

squat.name: Jump Squat
squat.cue: Arms loose at sides. Squat to parallel, explode up fully, land soft and reset each rep.

squat.name: Sumo Squat
squat.cue: Feet wider than shoulders, toes out 45°. Sit straight down, drive knees out over toes.

squat.name: Banded Squat
squat.cue: Loop heavy band above knees, feet shoulder-width. Squat down while pressing knees out against the band.

squat.name: DB Overhead Squat
squat.cue: Press both light DBs to full lockout overhead, biceps by ears. Squat to full depth keeping DBs stable overhead.

squat.name: Pistol Squat
squat.cue: Stand on one foot, extend the other leg straight out in front. Sit all the way down on one leg, drive up to standing.

hinge.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
hinge.cue: Hold DBs at thighs, soft knees. Push hips back slow, lower DBs to mid-shin, drive hips through to stand.

hinge.name: DB Deadlift
hinge.cue: DBs on floor outside feet. Flat back, drive the floor away, stand to full lockout with hips forward.

hinge.name: DB Hang Power Clean
hinge.cue: DBs at thighs. Dip-shrug-pull, elbows whip under fast, catch DBs on the shoulders.

hinge.name: Good Morning
hinge.cue: Hands behind head, soft knees, feet hip-width. Hinge at hips with flat back, squeeze glutes to stand.

hinge.name: Banded Good Morning
hinge.cue: Step on heavy band, loop top over traps. Hinge with flat back against tension, stand tall, squeeze glutes.

hinge.name: Single-Leg DB RDL
hinge.cue: One DB in opposite-side hand. Hinge on one leg, reach DB to shin, keep hips level.

hinge.name: DB Swing
hinge.cue: Hold one DB with both hands by the horns, feet shoulder-width. Hinge and swing DB between legs, then snap hips to swing DB to chest height.

hinge.name: DB Snatch
hinge.cue: One DB on the floor between feet. Pull explosively with one arm, punch DB overhead to full lockout in one motion.

hinge.name: DB Sumo Deadlift High Pull
hinge.cue: Wide stance, toes out, one DB hanging in both hands between legs. Drive through hips, pull DB to chin, elbows high.

lunge.name: Reverse Lunge
lunge.cue: Stand tall, hands on hips. Step one leg back, drop rear knee to floor, drive up through front heel.

lunge.name: Walking Lunge
lunge.cue: Step forward into a long lunge, rear knee kisses floor. Drive up, alternate legs walking forward.

lunge.name: DB Lunge
lunge.cue: Hold DBs at sides, shoulders packed. Step forward or back, drop rear knee under hip, drive up.

lunge.name: Lateral Lunge
lunge.cue: Feet wide apart, toes pointing forward. Shift weight into one hip to sit low, other leg straight.

lunge.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
lunge.cue: Rear foot on bench behind, front foot planted forward. Drop straight down, drive up through front heel.

lunge.name: DB Step-Up
lunge.cue: Hold DBs at sides, step box in front. Plant full foot on box, drive through heel to stand tall.

lunge.name: Jump Lunge
lunge.cue: Start in a lunge, both knees at 90°. Explode up and switch legs mid-air, land soft in opposite lunge.

lunge.name: DB Overhead Lunge
lunge.cue: Press both light DBs to lockout overhead. Step into a lunge keeping DBs stable overhead, alternate legs.

lunge.name: DB Front-Rack Lunge
lunge.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders, elbows pointed up. Step into a lunge, rear knee to floor, drive back up.

carry.name: DB Farmer Carry
carry.cue: One DB in each hand at sides, shoulders packed back. Walk tall, ribs down, quick short steps.

carry.name: Single-Arm DB Carry
carry.cue: One DB at side, free hand on hip. Walk the distance resisting any side lean, then switch.

carry.name: DB Overhead Carry
carry.cue: Press both light DBs to full lockout overhead. Biceps by ears, core tight, walk steady.

carry.name: DB Suitcase Carry
carry.cue: Hold one DB at side like a suitcase. Resist the tilt, stay perfectly vertical, even step tempo.

carry.name: DB Front-Rack Carry
carry.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders, elbows pointed up. Brace hard, walk with short fast steps.

carry.name: DB Mixed Carry
carry.cue: Light DB pressed overhead, heavy DB at side. Walk distance tall, then switch hands.

carry.name: DB Zercher Carry
carry.cue: Cradle one DB in the crook of both elbows, hugged to torso. Walk upright, core braced, short fast steps.

carry.name: DB Waiter Walk
carry.cue: Hold one light DB overhead at full lockout like carrying a tray. Walk slowly, shoulder stable, then switch.

strengthPool.name: DB Hang Power Clean
strengthPool.cue: Start DBs at thighs. Aggressive hip drive, shrug, whip elbows under to catch on shoulders. Reset each rep.

strengthPool.name: Strict Pull-Up
strengthPool.cue: Overhand grip shoulder-width, full dead hang. Pull chin over bar without kipping, control the lower.

strengthPool.name: DB Push Press
strengthPool.cue: DBs racked on shoulders. Dip 2 in. through legs, drive hard, punch DBs to full overhead lockout.

strengthPool.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
strengthPool.cue: Hold DBs at thighs, soft knees. Push hips back slowly, feel hamstring stretch, drive hips through to stand.

strengthPool.name: DB Floor Press
strengthPool.cue: Lie flat on the floor, DBs at chest, feet planted. Press straight to lockout, pause triceps on floor each rep.

strengthPool.name: DB Bent-Over Row
strengthPool.cue: Hinge forward with DBs hanging, flat back. Row both DBs to hips, squeeze shoulder blades together at top.

strengthPool.name: DB Front Squat
strengthPool.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders, elbows up high. Squat below parallel with tall torso, drive up through heels.

strengthPool.name: Single-Arm DB Row
strengthPool.cue: One hand braced on bench, DB in other hand. Row DB to hip, drive elbow to ceiling, squeeze at top.

strengthPool.name: DB Deadlift
strengthPool.cue: DBs on floor outside feet. Flat back, shoulders over DBs, drive floor away to full standing lockout.

strengthPool.name: Pike Push-Up
strengthPool.cue: Feet planted, hips piked high over shoulders. Lower crown to floor, press up tall to full lockout.

strengthPool.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
strengthPool.cue: Rear foot on bench, front leg planted forward. Drop straight down until rear knee hovers, drive up through front heel.

strengthPool.name: Chin-Up
strengthPool.cue: Underhand shoulder-width grip, full dead hang. Pull chin over bar, squeeze biceps hard at top.

strengthPool.name: DB Hang Power Clean
strengthPool.cue: DBs at thighs. Heavier focus today: explosive hip pop, elbows whip under fast, solid shoulder catch.

strengthPool.name: Strict Pull-Up
strengthPool.cue: Overhand grip, chin over bar at start. Lower with a slow 3-count negative to full dead hang each rep.

strengthPool.name: DB Thruster
strengthPool.cue: Rack both DBs on shoulders. Squat below parallel, drive up and press overhead in one fluid motion each rep.

strengthPool.name: DB Renegade Row
strengthPool.cue: Plank on both DBs, feet wide for stability. Row one DB to hip, set it down, alternate. Stay rigid through the core.

strengthPool.name: DB Swing
strengthPool.cue: Both hands on one DB by the horns. Hinge and swing between legs, snap hips to chest height. Control each swing.

strengthPool.name: DB Strict Press
strengthPool.cue: Stand tall, DBs racked on shoulders. Press overhead with zero leg drive, control the lower each rep.

accessoryPool.name: Banded Face Pull
accessoryPool.cue: Anchor light band at face height, hold one end in each hand. Pull to forehead, elbows high, pause at back.

accessoryPool.name: Single-Arm DB Row
accessoryPool.cue: Brace one hand on a bench, DB in the other. Row DB to hip, elbow tight to body, squeeze at top.

accessoryPool.name: Hanging Knee Raises
accessoryPool.cue: Dead hang from the bar, shoulders active. Brace core, lift knees to chest, slow lower, no swing.

accessoryPool.name: Banded Pull-Apart
accessoryPool.cue: Hold light band at arm's length in front, palms down. Pull band apart to chest, pinch shoulder blades.

accessoryPool.name: Banded Good Morning
accessoryPool.cue: Step on heavy band, loop top over back of neck. Hinge with flat back, stand tall, squeeze glutes.

accessoryPool.name: Hollow Body Hold
accessoryPool.cue: Lie on back, press lower back flat into floor. Lift legs and shoulders off, arms overhead, hold hollow.

accessoryPool.name: DB Hammer Curl
accessoryPool.cue: Hold DBs with neutral grip (thumbs up). Curl up without swinging, slow negative, elbows pinned to sides.

accessoryPool.name: DB Tricep Kickback
accessoryPool.cue: Hinge forward with DBs, upper arms locked parallel to torso. Extend DBs back, only elbows move.

accessoryPool.name: Dead Hang
accessoryPool.cue: Hang from the bar at full arm extension. Keep shoulders active (slight pull down), breathe steady.

accessoryPool.name: Banded Glute Bridge
accessoryPool.cue: Loop heavy band above knees, lie on back with feet planted. Press knees out, drive hips to ceiling.

accessoryPool.name: DB Lateral Raise
accessoryPool.cue: Hold light DBs at sides, slight bend in elbows. Raise both arms out to shoulder height, control the lower.

accessoryPool.name: Plank Hold
accessoryPool.cue: Forearms on floor, body in a straight line from head to heels. Brace core, don't let hips sag, breathe steady.

accessoryPool.name: DB Skull Crusher
accessoryPool.cue: Lie flat, press both DBs above face, palms facing. Bend only at elbows, lower DBs toward forehead, press back up.

accessoryPool.name: V-Up
accessoryPool.cue: Lie flat on back, arms extended overhead. Simultaneously raise legs and torso, reach hands to toes at the top.
